# Romi

> Romi is an AI personal companion for adults with ADHD, built in the UK by Neuro Notion App Limited. It offers conversational self-management support for everyday organisation and wellbeing: task breakdown, routines, reminders, scheduling, note capture and guided regulation exercises. Romi does not diagnose, assess or treat any condition.

Romi is a web app at https://app.romiadhd.com. The marketing site, product documentation and an ADHD editorial library live at https://www.romiadhd.com. Content is written in plain English for adults, UK-focused, by a team who live with ADHD themselves.

## Product

- [What is the Romi ADHD app](https://www.romiadhd.com/adhd-app): overview of the app, who it is for, pricing and FAQs
- [Product documentation](https://www.romiadhd.com/docs): how Romi works, feature by feature
- [Getting started](https://www.romiadhd.com/docs/getting-started): first steps in the app
- [Free ADHD Notion templates](https://www.romiadhd.com/templates): free planning, task and habit templates
- [About Romi and the team](https://www.romiadhd.com/about): founder story and why Romi exists

- [Understanding ADHD in adults](https://www.romiadhd.com/understanding-adhd): plain-English starting point

- [ADHD and emotional regulation](https://www.romiadhd.com/adhd-emotional-regulation): rejection sensitivity, anxiety, burnout, overwhelm
- [ADHD at work](https://www.romiadhd.com/adhd-at-work): disclosure, UK Equality Act 2010 rights, reasonable adjustments
- [ADHD and daily life](https://www.romiadhd.com/adhd-daily-life): sleep, routines, habits and structure
